products.name: Magick Box
products.blurb: AI creative platform on iOS, Android and the web
highlights: Built the backend in Python 3.12 with FastAPI and Pydantic: around 250 REST endpoints across 21 feature packages.
Structured the codebase as feature-sliced Clean Architecture with interface-based repositories and an async dependency-injection layer.
Designed the MongoDB data model: around 58 collections with indexes and aggregation pipelines.
Wrote the feed ranker, blending time-decayed vote score with follow, tag and content-type affinity.
Used Redis for caching with TTL invalidation, a sliding-window rate limiter, and Socket.IO pub/sub across pods.
Integrated text, image, video, music and podcast generation across seven providers behind one abstraction, with credit-based model tiers.
Ran long generation jobs on Celery with late acknowledgements, exponential backoff and time limits.
Built Mini Cinema, a multi-shot AI film pipeline that streams reasoning, approval gates and renders as typed content blocks.
Built real-time chat over Socket.IO with token streaming, per-user chat locks and a content-block message schema.
Built group chat mixing human members with AI personas: invitations, admin roles, mentions and unread tracking.
Implemented device-bound JWT sessions, Argon2 hashing with legacy migration, email OTP, and Google and Apple sign-in.
Implemented Stripe and RevenueCat billing with signature-verified webhooks and an idempotent credit ledger.
Wrote 181 pytest tests across chat orchestration, feed ranking, payments and session authorisation.
Deployed to Kubernetes on AWS with Helm, Istio mTLS and horizontal autoscaling, from one Docker image serving both web and worker.

products.name: Magick Whisper
products.blurb: Dog-training companion for the Guardian collar, in development
highlights: Wrote the Go API with Gin and pgx over PostgreSQL: hand-written SQL and embedded goose migrations.
Implemented Google and Apple ID-token verification against cached JWKS, 15-minute access tokens and rotating hashed refresh tokens.
Returned RFC 7807 problem responses with per-field validation, plus request-ID logging and readiness probes.
Wrote 134 Go tests that run against a real Postgres service in CI, with a check that fails the build if a database test skips.
Built the Flutter app with Riverpod and go_router, with on-device speech recognition through Whisper and Silero VAD.
Kept sign-in optional and off the onboarding path to meet App Store guideline 5.1.1.
Shipped through GitHub Actions for tests and Codemagic for signed iOS and Android releases.

products.name: Internal compliance tooling
products.blurb: Audit and compliance software for the bank's legal team
highlights: Built internal compliance and audit tools, replacing manual checks with a tracked workflow.
Designed and maintained REST APIs in Java, with relational schema design and SQL behind the reporting datasets.
Processed data for internal reports and worked in a Git workflow with code reviews.
Built front-end features in JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
